description: This file defines the JobSpecification controller class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for handling file-related requests related to job specifications, including retrieving attachments by ID.

classes.name: JobSpecification
classes.description: Controller class managing file retrieval for job specifications, especially downloading attachments.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService used to manage job title related data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming request to retrieve a job specification attachment by ID, sets appropriate headers, and returns the file content, or handles bad request scenarios.
